why: No major reviewer or authority answers the all-SSD NAS question: TechSpot and PC Gamer appear but on HDD NAS picks and SSD drive deals. Only one niche page (computingforgeeks) addresses all-flash NAS, and it relays other reviewers' numbers without a budget filter; the rest are general 4-bay roundups, spec databases and cache-SSD guides. A focused page comparing the all-NVMe units under $900 with current prices and a clear pick would stand out.
